rules.before_visible:
Relative to the released B curve, X5 equivalent strengths were available in \resultnum{v4x.comparisons.count.x5.equivalent.available}{[n]} condition--share readings, gap-censored in \resultnum{v4x.comparisons.count.x5.equivalent.censored}{[n]}, above the complete grid in \resultnum{v4x.comparisons.count.x5.equivalent.above-grid}{[n]}, and unavailable in \resultnum{v4x.comparisons.count.x5.equivalent.unavailable}{[n]} (Table~\ref{tab:v4x-stress-comparisons}). 
These are first point-AUC crossings, without interpolation: a crossing before the first gap remains reportable, an earlier gap censors a missing crossing, and no crossing on a complete grid is above the grid. 
The X5 interval overlapped, lay strictly above or lay strictly below the band at B's first point boundary in \resultnum{v4x.comparisons.count.x5.interval.overlap}{[n]}, \resultnum{v4x.comparisons.count.x5.interval.above}{[n]} and \resultnum{v4x.comparisons.count.x5.interval.below}{[n]} readings; \resultnum{v4x.comparisons.count.x5.interval.unavailable}{[n]} comparisons were unavailable. 
Overlap includes shared endpoints; these local descriptive relations neither calibrate the SHP channel nor identify causal influence.

These are first point-AUC attainments, without interpolation: an attainment before the first gap remains reportable, an earlier gap censors a missing attainment, and no attainment on a complete grid is above the grid.

rules.before_visible: > Opinion panels can resemble partner drift or persistence when exposure is unobserved. We evaluate a synthetic detection boundary for a fixed lag-based discriminator against matched no-network persistence. An eleven-wave rank-transported autoregression combines bounded-confidence-shaped drift and an unobserved random network; first-order drift depends on individual state. Panels use Swiss Household Panel geometry and a response signal share known to both arms. Nulls match short-lag population moments. The primary estimand is the curve of first grid strengths whose expected AUC against trait-plus-autoregressive persistence reaches 0.70.
rules.after_visible: > Opinion panels can resemble partner drift or persistence when exposure is unobserved. We map the nominal drift needed for a fixed lag-based discriminator to separate synthetic panels from matched no-network persistence. Eleven-wave panels approximate Swiss Household Panel geometry with response signal share $r$ known to both arms. Nulls match short-lag population moments. The boundary $a^*(r)$ is the first grid strength whose expected panel-level area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) reaches 0.70 against trait-plus-autoregressive persistence. Small and large denote interval-based regions divided at 0.03.
rules.decision: T38a: nova abertura pela pergunta, AUC por painel e corte convencional 0.03; condição universal e posição inicial preservadas. Oráculo atual separado do ensaio histórico. Limite explicitamente corrigido para a citação 13:13; nota editorial 15 não pertence ao resumo.
